title: AFTER
description: The full *After* saga follows Tessa and Hardin’s intense love story—starting as strangers in college and growing into a rollercoaster of passion, betrayal, and deep secrets. From their first spark in *After*, to the heartbreaks in *After We Collided*, and the challenges in *After We Fell*, their bond is tested again in *After Ever Happy*. Finally, *After Everything* brings closure, healing, and a chance at real peace. VJ Junior delivers every twist with fire and flavor!
